description: Refund part or all of a payment (owner or office, or their agent). The reply says requested. Confirmation arrives shortly, and invoices.get is where the confirmed refund shows. An agent refund above the shop's agent refund cap (shops.setAgentMoney, $250 unless the owner changed it) does not run: it waits for the owner's OK and the reply says approval_required.
name: invoices_refund
